shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,145p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,42p' CHANGELOG.md && cat package.json | head -75 && test -e scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; echo reanchor:"'$?; test -e scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs; echo repoint:$?'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#|spec:' src/orchestration/*.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -50 && sed -n '1,150p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n 'beforeSession|onError' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | head -35"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.+#[0-9]+|@spec|VALIDATED_BY|\"spec\"|spec\\?:' src scripts/lore* .lore | head -70 && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '10,26p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '26,50p' && git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat && git diff --check && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts | sed -n '1,12p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '38,42p' && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git diff --no-index /dev/null src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts || true'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts && git commit -m 'fix(orchestrator): run hooks after setup failure' -m 'Fixes #94'"
